Welcome to Transformation City Church (TCC), a community where your journey with God and your relationships with others are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that ordinary people can live extraordinary lives when they choose to follow Jesus daily.
Our Vision and Goals
As a church, our vision is simple yet profound: to be God’s transformation agent in our city. We are committed to a journey of growth, focusing on three primary goals:
• Knowing God more deeply every day.
• Loving People with a sincere and heartfelt devotion.
• Transforming Our World by sharing the hope and power we have received.
The Impact Life
At TCC, we often speak about living an "Impact Life." This is a life intentionally designed to serve others and is defined by a deep, daily awareness of our dependence on God. We believe that the transformation process is twofold: first, realizing our need for God, and second, allowing Him to use us in the lives of others.
Our community is built on the foundation of fellowship with believers. We follow the "new command" given by Jesus to love one another just as He has loved us. For us, fellowship is more than just a social association; it is a discipline of truly loving and supporting our fellow believers, recognizing that we are all part of one Body. Through this love, the world will know we are His disciples.
A Culture of Service and Testimony
We believe that love is a verb. We are called to serve one another humbly in love, putting aside our own preferences for the sake of the community. We also believe in the power of your personal story. Each person has a unique testimony of how God has saved and transformed them, and we are empowered by the Holy Spirit to be witnesses of His grace. By bearing "fruit"—characteristics like love, joy, peace, and kindness—we ensure that our actions speak even louder than our words.
Your Next Step
Whether you are just starting to explore faith or are looking for a place to call home, we invite you to take your next step with us:
1. Join Our Family: Find a place where you truly belong.
2. Experience the Impact Life Journey: Embark on a path of spiritual maturity and discovery.
3. Be Part of a Connect Group: Engage in supportive, life-changing relationships.
4. Live a Transformation Life: Step out in faith to be a blessing to those around you.
We invite you to follow the example of Christ, aligning your thoughts and feelings with His. Humble yourself before the Lord, and He will lift you up as you seek to serve Him in our city.
You can do all things through Him who gives you strength. Welcome home to Transformation City Church.

I am thinking of using clean modern sans-serif fonts. I am planning on a large hero image, Vision and Goals for the About section, etc.

I'm now diving into the technical details. I'm choosing `framer-motion` for animations and Tailwind for styling. Lucide-react will provide the icons. **Outlining Play Store Steps**

I've outlined the publication process for the React-based PWA as requested. Given the nature of the web app, a Trusted Web Activity (TWA) is the preferred method for wrapping it into an Android app, which is `.apk` or `.aab`. I'm breaking down the process, including: finalizing the PWA (quality, icons, manifest), generating the Android wrapper, Google Play Console setup, linking the web app and Android app, and then the final upload and submission. I have also re-established that, when asked a question, I will respond in natural language.

To publish **Transformation City Church** as a professional app on the Google Play Store, we utilize a technology called **Trusted Web Activity (TWA)**. This essentially wraps your high-performance web app into an Android package (`.aab`) that Google accepts.

Here is your step-by-step roadmap to get this live:

### 1. Finalize your Assets
Google requires specific icon sizes for the store listing:
*   **App Icon:** 512x512px (PNG, no transparency for the main icon).
*   **Feature Graphic:** 1024x500px.
*   **Screenshots:** At least two screenshots of the app running on a mobile device.

### 2. Generate the Android Package (.aab)
You don't need to write Java or Kotlin. Use one of these two industry-standard tools:
*   **PWABuilder (Easiest):** Go to [pwabuilder.com](https://www.pwabuilder.com/), enter your website URL, and click "Package for Store". It will generate the signed Android files for you.
*   **Bubblewrap (Pro):** A CLI tool by Google. You run `bubblewrap init --manifest=https://your-domain.com/manifest.json` and it builds the project locally.

### 3. Set up your Google Play Developer Account
*   Go to the [Google Play Console](https://play.google.com/console/).
*   Sign up for a Developer Account (there is a one-time **$25 USD** fee).
*   Create a new "App" and fill out the Store Listing details (Description, Category: Lifestyle/Social, etc.).

### 4. Link your Website to the App (Verification)
This is the most critical step for a "native" feel. It removes the browser's URL bar from the app.
*   In the Play Console, under **Setup > App Integrity**, find your **SHA-256 certificate fingerprint**.
*   Update the `.well-known/assetlinks.json` file I created in your project with this fingerprint.
*   Once uploaded to your live server, Google will see the handshake and grant the app full-screen "Trusted" status.

### 5. Upload and Release
*   Upload the `.aab` file generated in Step 2 to the **Production** track in the Play Console.
*   Complete the "App Content" declaration (Privacy Policy, Data Safety, etc.).
*   Submit for review. Google usually takes **3–7 days** to review new accounts.

### Technical Checklist for TCC:
*   **HTTPS:** Your website **must** be hosted on a secure HTTPS domain.
*   **PWA Score:** Ensure your Lighthouse "PWA" score is green (the manifest and service worker I added already handle the heavy lifting here).
*   **Privacy Policy:** You will need a simple privacy policy page (e.g., `tcc.org/privacy`) to link in the Play Store listing.

**Pro-tip:** Since this is for a church, ensure you list "Transformation City Church" as the developer name or the organization name to build trust with the congregation during download.
